discovery_outcomes.student_guide_word_document: located; methodological guidance, not a testing/training pair manifest

limitations: A discovery result is not proof that files never existed or were never shared.
Credential/history locations, environments, caches, model/checkpoint trees and other program/security state were excluded.
Two media locations were permission-restricted; unmounted storage, other user accounts and remote shares were not searched.
Symlinks were not followed. Raw fingerprint images and screenshots were not OCRed; all 24 PDFs had extractable text.
Keyword/schema/population checks aid discovery; no unavailable testing or training records were reconstructed.
scope: Read-only discovery in the user home and accessible media/mount locations; no matcher or training run
